---
title: "Супервізія: опитування педагогів"
format: dashboard
---

```{r}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(arrow)
library(scales)
library(openxlsx)

# ---- data -------------------------------------------------------------------
agg_cols <- c("ID", "admin", "admin_category", "option", "variable", "perc",
              "general_count", "option_orig", "variable_orig")
agg <- read_parquet("inputs/dashboard_data/clean_df.parquet", col_select = all_of(agg_cols)) %>%
  mutate(response_count = round(perc * general_count))
# Data problems (wrong labels, doubled prefixes, stale tables) are NOT patched here:
# `python check_sheet.py` reports them and they are fixed at the source.

# Overall (unfiltered) rows of one variable
get_overall <- function(code) {
  agg %>% filter(variable_orig == code, admin == "Overall")
}
get_label <- function(code) {
  get_overall(code)$variable[1]
}
get_n <- function(code) {
  get_overall(code)$general_count[1]
}

# Oblast polygons; rebuild recipe: data/build_oblast_geo.R
oblast_geo <- sf::st_read("data/oblast_geo.geojson", quiet = TRUE)

# ---- palette ----------------------------------------------------------------
txt_color  <- "#1b2f4a"
bar_color  <- "#2f6fb3"
donut_cols <- c("#143a6b", "#4f8ccb", "#bcd6ef")
map_ramp       <- c("#bcd3ea", "#8db8e0", "#5b97d0", "#2f6fb3", "#143a6b")
map_zero_color <- "#f3e6cf"
map_na_color   <- "#8a8a8a"
kpi_pct_color  <- "#1d4f91"
kpi_avg_color  <- "#1a7f8e"

# ---- shared chart helpers ---------------------------------------------------
wrap_label <- function(x, width = 28) {
  vapply(x, function(s) paste(strwrap(s, width), collapse = "<br>"), character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

# note: optional smaller second line (e.g. "можна обрати кілька варіантів")
# width: wrap column; 120 fits a full-width chart, use ~60 for half-width ones
chart_title <- function(text, note = NULL, width = 120) {
  txt <- wrap_label(text, width)
  if (!is.null(note)) {
    txt <- paste0(txt, "<br><span style='font-size:12px;font-weight:normal'>", note, "</span>")
  }
  list(
    text = txt, font = list(size = 14, color = txt_color),
    x = 0.01, xanchor = "left", y = 1, yanchor = "top", yref = "container",
    pad = list(t = 26), automargin = TRUE
  )
}

bar_labels <- function(p, tickformat) {
  style(p, texttemplate = paste0("%{x:", tickformat, "}"), textposition = "outside",
        cliponaxis = FALSE,
        hovertemplate = paste0("%{y}<br>%{x:", tickformat, "}<extra></extra>"))
}

bar_xaxis <- function(tickformat) {
  ax <- list(tickformat = tickformat, showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE)
  if (tickformat == ".0%") ax$range <- c(0, 1)
  ax
}

# Single-series horizontal bars over `option`. `order` = option_orig values
# top to bottom; NULL sorts by value (largest on top).
hbar <- function(df, color = bar_color, value_col = "perc", tickformat = ".0%",
                 title = NULL, order = NULL) {
  df <- if (is.null(order)) df %>% arrange(desc(.data[[value_col]])) else df[match(order, df$option_orig), ]
  df$label <- wrap_label(df$option)
  p <- plot_ly(df, x = df[[value_col]], y = df$label, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
               marker = list(color = color), customdata = df$response_count) %>%
    bar_labels(tickformat) %>%
    style(hovertemplate = paste0("%{y}<br>%{x:", tickformat, "} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>")) %>%
    layout(
      title = title,
      xaxis = bar_xaxis(tickformat),
      yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = rev(df$label),
                   showgrid = FALSE, zeroline = FALSE, automargin = TRUE),
      margin = list(r = 50),
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(color = txt_color)
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  p
}

# ---- maps -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Manual legend instead of colorBin so the scale stays fixed (see CLAUDE.md "Maps").
# "perc": fixed 20 % bins; "share": finer bins for small shares of all respondents.
# ("capped" - 95th-percentile bins for statistics/counts - is added when a numeric
# page needs it.)
map_scale <- function(values, mode = c("share", "perc")) {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  pct <- values * 100
  if (mode == "share") {
    breaks <- c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20, Inf)
    labs   <- c("1–5 %", "6–10 %", "11–15 %", "16–20 %", "> 20 %")
    bin    <- cut(pct, breaks, labels = FALSE, right = TRUE)
  } else {
    breaks <- c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80, Inf)
    labs   <- c("1–19 %", "20–39 %", "40–59 %", "60–79 %", "80–100 %")
    bin    <- cut(pct, breaks, labels = FALSE, right = FALSE)
  }
  colors <- ifelse(is.na(pct), map_na_color,
            ifelse(pct == 0, map_zero_color, map_ramp[bin]))
  legend_colors <- c(map_zero_color, map_ramp)
  legend_labels <- c("0 %", labs)
  if (anyNA(values)) {
    legend_colors <- c(legend_colors, map_na_color)
    legend_labels <- c(legend_labels, "немає даних")
  }
  list(colors = colors, legend_colors = legend_colors, legend_labels = legend_labels)
}

# ---- value boxes ------------------------------------------------------------
# Quarto escapes HTML in a value box's `value`, so the count goes into the title.
# "% yes" cards: the number of respondents who gave the counted answer(s);
# "average" cards (yes_options = NULL): everyone who answered. Non-breaking
# spaces so a number never wraps mid-way.
kpi_title <- function(label, code, yes_options = NULL) {
  nb <- " "
  if (is.null(yes_options)) {
    sprintf("%s (відповіли%s%s)", label, nb, comma(get_n(code), big.mark = nb))
  } else {
    d <- get_overall(code)
    n <- sum(d$response_count[d$option_orig %in% yes_options])
    sprintf("%s (%s%sреспондентів)", label, comma(n, big.mark = nb), nb)
  }
}
# Subtitle line under a chart title: the question's total respondents, plus an
# optional extra (e.g. the multi-select note).
answered_note <- function(code, extra = NULL) {
  paste(c(sprintf("Відповіли %s", comma(get_n(code), big.mark = " ")), extra), collapse = " · ")
}
# Share of respondents giving one of `yes_options` (option_orig values).
kpi_pct <- function(code, yes_options, icon) {
  d <- get_overall(code)
  list(icon = icon, color = kpi_pct_color,
       value = percent(sum(d$perc[d$option_orig %in% yes_options]), accuracy = 1))
}
# Mean of a 1-5 rating, from the per-score shares.
kpi_avg <- function(code, icon) {
  d <- get_overall(code)
  m <- sum(as.numeric(d$option_orig) * d$perc) / sum(d$perc)
  list(icon = icon, color = kpi_avg_color,
       value = sprintf("%.1f / 5", m))
}
```

# Поінформованість

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
#| include: false
# ---- data for pages 1-5, shipped to the browser as JSON (static dashboard) ------
# sheet_classification.xlsx is the single source for the page structure: which cards are
# on which page ("pages"), in which order, drawn how (the controlled chart vocabulary),
# the dropdown choices ("main" + "breakdowns") and the small-group threshold. The KoBo
# form says which questions are select_multiple (shares sum to more than 100 %).
# Data problems are NOT worked around here: `python check_sheet.py` reports them.
# openxlsx returns this file's non-ASCII text entity-encoded ("&#1044;..."): Plotly
# would still draw it, but sorting by label and wrapping by length would not work.
decode_entities <- function(x) {
  vapply(x, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s) || !grepl("&", s, fixed = TRUE)) return(s)
    for (cd in unique(regmatches(s, gregexpr("&#[0-9]+;", s))[[1]]))
      s <- gsub(cd, intToUtf8(as.integer(gsub("[&#;]", "", cd))), s, fixed = TRUE)
    gsub("&amp;", "&", s, fixed = TRUE)
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
decode_df <- function(d) { d[] <- lapply(d, function(col) if (is.character(col)) decode_entities(col) else col); d }
sheet_path <- "inputs/dashboard_data/sheet_classification.xlsx"
sheet    <- decode_df(read.xlsx(sheet_path, sheet = "survey"))
pspec    <- decode_df(read.xlsx(sheet_path, sheet = "main"))
bk_sheet <- decode_df(read.xlsx(sheet_path, sheet = "breakdowns"))
vocab    <- decode_df(read.xlsx(sheet_path, sheet = "lists"))
kobo     <- read.xlsx("inputs/supervision_survey_educators_2.xlsx", sheet = "survey")
multi_codes <- kobo$name[grepl("^select_multiple", kobo$type)]

# fail loudly on a word outside the vocabulary instead of guessing what was meant
for (cl in c("Graph_type", "page_0_graph_type", "Page_gen_type_graph", "Page_graph_disag_chosen",
             "Orientation_overall", "Layout_hint", "Multi_select", "Hidden_when_breakdown", "asked_of")) {
  lst <- if (cl %in% c("Multi_select", "Hidden_when_breakdown")) "yes_no" else cl
  bad <- setdiff(na.omit(sheet[[cl]]), na.omit(vocab[[lst]]))
  if (length(bad)) stop("sheet_classification.xlsx, column ", cl, ": ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "),
                        " is not in the vocabulary (see the legend sheet)", call. = FALSE)
}
page_of   <- function(s) as.integer(strsplit(as.character(s), "[;,]")[[1]])
std_pages <- pspec$page[pspec$page_type == "type5_standard"]
cmp_page  <- pspec$page[pspec$page_type == "type5_comparison"]
spec_of   <- function(p) pspec[pspec$page == p, ]
p_admins  <- unique(c("Overall", unlist(strsplit(pspec$breakdowns[pspec$page %in% std_pages], ";"))))

membership <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(sheet)), function(i) {
  pg <- page_of(sheet$pages[i]); pg <- pg[pg %in% std_pages]   # the comparison page has its own builder
  if (!length(pg)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(code = sheet$name[i], page = pg, g = sheet$Page_gen_type_graph[i],
             d = sheet$Page_graph_disag_chosen[i], orient = sheet$Orientation_overall[i],
             pos = sheet$Card_order[i], layout_hint = sheet$Layout_hint[i])
}))
pg_cfg <- membership %>%
  mutate(
    overall = case_when(g == "kpi_card" ~ "kpi", g == "donut" ~ "donut", g == "bar" ~ "bar"),
    disag   = case_when(d == "stacked_bar" ~ "stacked", d == "heatmap" ~ "heatmap", d == "mean_bar" ~ "mean"),
    label = vapply(code, get_label, character(1)),
    multi = code %in% multi_codes,
    keep_order = code == "q_years",                  # chronological, not by value
    vertical = coalesce(orient == "vertical", FALSE), # overall bar drawn as columns that fill their row
    layout_hint = coalesce(layout_hint, "auto"),
    min_n = vapply(page, function(p) as.numeric(spec_of(p)$min_n), numeric(1))
  )
if (anyNA(pg_cfg$pos) || any(duplicated(pg_cfg[c("page", "pos")])))
  stop("sheet_classification.xlsx: Card_order must be filled and unique within each page", call. = FALSE)
pg_cfg <- pg_cfg %>% arrange(page, pos)
# a pie/donut needs mutually exclusive answers
stopifnot(!any(pg_cfg$multi & pg_cfg$overall == "donut"), !anyNA(pg_cfg$overall), !anyNA(pg_cfg$disag))
codes_all <- unique(pg_cfg$code)
vmin <- pg_cfg %>% distinct(code, min_n)   # small-group threshold of the page a question is on

# Fixed answer order (option_orig) where it is meaningful - most to least
# positive. Everything else: numbers ascending, else by overall share. Neutral
# answers always go last and are grey.
p_order <- list(
  q_awareness      = c("understand_well", "partial", "heard_not_understand", "not_familiar"),
  q_know_how_order = c("yes", "partial", "no"),
  q_info_enough    = c("yes", "partial", "no"),
  q_staff_informed = c("all", "most", "some", "no"),
  q_participated   = c("yes", "no"),
  q_tried_order    = c("yes_success", "yes_failed", "no"),
  q_staff_applied  = c("many_times", "once", "isolated_cases", "no", "dont_know"),
  q_organized_level = c("systematically", "episodically", "no"),
  q_applied_results = c("fully", "partially", "not_yet", "no_recommendations"),
  q_admin_role     = c("actively_initiates", "supports")
)
neutral_opts <- c("other", "dk", "dont_know", "did_not_receive")
ramps <- list(
  "1" = "#2f6fb3",
  "2" = c("#143a6b", "#7fb0de"),
  "3" = c("#143a6b", "#4f8ccb", "#bcd6ef"),
  "4" = c("#143a6b", "#2f6fb3", "#7fb0de", "#bcd6ef"),
  "5" = c("#143a6b", "#2f6fb3", "#5b97d0", "#8fbbe3", "#c3dbf0")
)
neutral_color <- "#b9c4d0"

pg_opts <- bind_rows(lapply(codes_all, function(cd) {
  o <- get_overall(cd) %>%
    transmute(code = cd, option_orig, option = sub("\\.0$", "", option), perc,
              neutral = option_orig %in% neutral_opts)
  num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(o$option_orig))
  o <- if (!is.null(p_order[[cd]])) {
    o %>% arrange(match(option_orig, p_order[[cd]]))
  } else if (!anyNA(num)) {
    o %>% arrange(as.numeric(option_orig))
  } else {
    o %>% arrange(neutral, desc(perc))
  }
  n <- sum(!o$neutral)
  cols <- if (n == 0) character(0) else if (n <= 5) ramps[[as.character(n)]] else
    colorRampPalette(c("#143a6b", "#bcd6ef"))(n)
  o$color <- neutral_color
  o$color[!o$neutral] <- cols
  o$rank <- seq_len(nrow(o))
  o %>% select(code, option_orig, option, rank, color)
}))

base <- agg %>% filter(variable_orig %in% codes_all, admin %in% p_admins)
cells <- base %>% distinct(variable_orig, admin, admin_category, general_count) %>%
  left_join(vmin, by = c("variable_orig" = "code"))
pg_dropped <- cells %>%
  filter(admin != "Overall") %>%
  group_by(variable_orig, admin) %>%
  summarise(n_dropped = sum(general_count < min_n), n_total = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Zero-fill: the pipeline omits options nobody chose in a category
pg_rows <- cells %>%
  filter(admin == "Overall" | general_count >= min_n) %>%
  inner_join(pg_opts %>% select(variable_orig = code, option_orig, rank),
             by = "variable_orig", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  left_join(base %>% select(variable_orig, admin, admin_category, option_orig, perc),
            by = c("variable_orig", "admin", "admin_category", "option_orig")) %>%
  mutate(perc = coalesce(perc, 0), count = round(perc * general_count)) %>%
  select(variable_orig, admin, admin_category, option_orig, rank,
         perc, count, base = general_count)

ojs_define(
  pg_cfg = pg_cfg %>% select(page, pos, code, label, multi, overall, disag, keep_order, vertical, layout_hint),
  pg_opts = pg_opts, pg_rows = pg_rows, pg_dropped = pg_dropped,
  pg_bk = bk_sheet %>% select(code, label_uk, title_suffix_uk, noun_uk, category_order),
  pg_spec = pspec %>% select(page, breakdowns, value_toggle, min_n)
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cfgs = transpose(pg_cfg)
opts = transpose(pg_opts)
rows = transpose(pg_rows)
dropped = transpose(pg_dropped)
bks = transpose(pg_bk)        // breakdowns sheet: labels, wording, category order
pspecs = transpose(pg_spec)   // main sheet: breakdown choices, value toggle, threshold
Plotly = require("plotly.js-dist-min@2.35.2")

// ---- sidebar controls, one set per page (choices come from the sheet) -----------
breakdownSelect = page => {
  const spec = pspecs.find(p => +p.page === page);
  const choices = spec.breakdowns.split(";").map(c => [bks.find(b => b.code === c).label_uk, c]);
  return Inputs.select(new Map(choices), {label: "Розбиття", value: "Overall"});
}
valueRadio = page => {
  const spec = pspecs.find(p => +p.page === page);
  if (spec.value_toggle !== "yes") {          // no toggle on this page: a hidden "perc"
    const el = html`<div hidden></div>`; el.value = "perc"; return el;
  }
  return Inputs.radio(new Map([["Відсотки", "perc"], ["Кількість", "count"]]),
    {label: "Показувати", value: "perc"});
}
resetButton = (disagInput, valueInput) => {
  const form = Inputs.button("Скинути", {reduce: () => {
    for (const [v, val] of [[disagInput, "Overall"], [valueInput, "perc"]]) {
      v.value = val;
      v.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    }
  }});
  form.querySelector("button").classList.add("p1-reset");
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Helpers shared by every Type 5 page kind (renderPage, renderComparePage):
// title/label styling and the card grid with its layout + redraw logic.
gridKit = {
  const TXT = "#1b2f4a";
  const wrap = (s, w) => {
    const lines = [];
    let cur = "";
    for (const word of String(s).split(" ")) {
      if (cur && (cur + " " + word).length > w) { lines.push(cur); cur = word; }
      else cur = cur ? cur + " " + word : word;
    }
    if (cur) lines.push(cur);
    return lines.join("<br>");
  };
  const titleOf = (text, note, w) => ({
    text: wrap(text, w) + (note ? `<br><span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:normal">${note}</span>` : ""),
    font: {size: 14, color: TXT}, x: 0.01, xanchor: "left", y: 1, yanchor: "top",
    yref: "container", pad: {t: 26}, automargin: true
  });
  // fixed system font stack: Plotly caches text widths measured before a web font loads
  const baseLayout = {paper_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    font: {color: TXT, family: "Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif"}};
  const isLight = hex => {
    const n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16);
    return (0.299 * (n >> 16) + 0.587 * ((n >> 8) & 255) + 0.114 * (n & 255)) > 140;
  };

  // cards: [{el, wide, slots, parts: [{plot, build(slots) -> {traces, layout, height}}]}]
  // (a card with a single `plot` + `build` is accepted too).
  // Two columns when there is room, one otherwise. A card that would be alone in
  // its row (last card, or the one before a full-width card) takes the whole row,
  // so the grid never leaves a blank half-row. Cards that share a row also share
  // a "slots" count (bars per plot), so their axes line up along the bottom.
  function mountGrid(cards, invalidation) {
    const root = html`<div class="p1-grid"></div>`;
    cards.forEach(c => root.appendChild(c.el));
    let rowGroups = [];  // the cards of each grid row, set by layoutGrid
    const layoutGrid = () => {
      const ncol = root.clientWidth >= 880 ? 2 : 1;
      root.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${ncol}, minmax(0, 1fr))`;
      const groups = [];
      let cur = [];
      const flush = () => { if (cur.length) groups.push(cur); cur = []; };
      cards.forEach((c, i) => {
        let full = c.wide || c.hint === "full_row";       // Layout_hint from the sheet
        if (c.hint === "new_row" && cur.length === 1) { cur[0].el.style.gridColumn = "1 / -1"; flush(); }
        else if (c.hint === "new_row") flush();
        if (full || ncol === 1) { flush(); groups.push([c]); }
        else {
          const next = cards[i + 1];
          if (cur.length === 0 && (!next || next.wide || next.hint === "full_row" || next.hint === "new_row")) { full = true; groups.push([c]); }
          else { cur.push(c); if (cur.length === 2) flush(); }
        }
        c.el.style.gridColumn = full ? "1 / -1" : "auto";
      });
      flush();
      groups.forEach(g => {
        const m = Math.max(0, ...g.map(c => c.slots));
        g.forEach(c => { c.useSlots = c.slots ? m : 0; });
      });
      rowGroups = groups;
    };
    let lastW = -1;
    const partsOf = c => c.parts || (c.plot && c.build ? [{plot: c.plot, build: c.build, fill: c.fill}] : []);
    const draw = () => {
      layoutGrid();
      // A part marked `fill` (a vertical bar chart) stretches to the height of the
      // tallest other card in its row, so it uses the space instead of leaving a gap.
      rowGroups.forEach(g => {
        const rowH = Math.max(0, ...g.map(c => partsOf(c).filter(p => !p.fill)
          .reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.build(c.useSlots).height, 0)));
        g.forEach(c => { c.rowH = rowH; });
      });
      cards.forEach(c => {
        partsOf(c).forEach(p => {
          const b = p.build(c.useSlots, c.rowH);
          p.plot.style.height = b.height + "px";
          Plotly.react(p.plot, b.traces, {...baseLayout, ...b.layout, height: b.height},
            {displayModeBar: false, responsive: true});
          Plotly.Plots.resize(p.plot);
        });
      });
    };
    // Plotly measures its container, so draw once the grid is in the document.
    const go = () => root.isConnected ? (lastW = root.clientWidth, draw()) : requestAnimationFrame(go);
    requestAnimationFrame(go);
    // Plotly's own `responsive` only listens to window resizes; the sidebar
    // opening/closing changes the container width without one.
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      if (Math.abs(root.clientWidth - lastW) < 2) return;
      lastW = root.clientWidth;
      draw();
    });
    ro.observe(root);
    invalidation.then(() => ro.disconnect());
    return root;
  }
  // category order of a breakdown comes from the breakdowns sheet: an explicit list, or by size
  const sortCats = (cats, bk, sizeOf) => {
    const ord = bk && bk.category_order;
    if (ord && ord !== "by_size") { const list = ord.split(";"); cats.sort((a, b) => list.indexOf(a) - list.indexOf(b)); }
    else cats.sort((a, b) => sizeOf(b) - sizeOf(a));
  };
  return {TXT, wrap, titleOf, baseLayout, isLight, mountGrid, sortCats};
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// One card grid per page: a card per variable, chart type chosen by (question
// kind x breakdown). See CLAUDE.md "Type 5".
renderPage = function(page, disag, valtype, invalidation) {
  const TXT = "#1b2f4a", BAR = "#2f6fb3", KPI = "#1a7f8e";
  const bkOf = code => bks.find(b => b.code === code) || {};
  const NOUN = new Proxy({}, {get: (_, k) => bkOf(k).noun_uk});             // from the breakdowns sheet
  const BY = new Proxy({}, {get: (_, k) => bkOf(k).title_suffix_uk});
  const MULTI_NOTE = "Можна обрати кілька варіантів";
  const MIN_N = +pspecs.find(p => +p.page === page).min_n;                  // from the main sheet
  const isCount = valtype === "count";
  const key = isCount ? "count" : "perc";
  const fmt = isCount ? ",d" : ".0%";
  const overall = disag === "Overall";

  const {wrap, titleOf, baseLayout, isLight, mountGrid, sortCats} = gridKit;
  const yAxis = (wide, slots) => ({
    ...(wide ? {autorange: "reversed"} : {range: [slots - 0.5, -0.5]}),
    type: "category", automargin: true, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, tickfont: {size: 11}});

  // px per bar in the overall bar charts: enough for the longest wrapped label on the page
  const barLines = Math.max(1, ...cfgs.filter(c => c.page === page && c.overall === "bar")
    .flatMap(c => opts.filter(d => d.code === c.code).map(d => wrap(d.option, 30).split("<br>").length)));
  const slotPx = Math.max(34, 14 * barLines + 10);

  // Top margin shared by every card on the page (cards in a row keep aligned
  // axes): room for the longest title as it would wrap in a half-width card,
  // plus the subtitle line.
  const titleLinesMax = Math.max(1, ...cfgs.filter(c => c.page === page).map(c =>
    wrap(`${c.label} (за стажем роботи), середня оцінка (1–5)`, 60).split("<br>").length));
  const topPx = 36 + 17 * (titleLinesMax + 1);

  const makeCard = c => {
    const o = opts.filter(d => d.code === c.code).sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);
    const rs = rows.filter(d => d.variable_orig === c.code && d.admin === disag);
    const cats = [...new Set(rs.map(d => d.admin_category))];
    const baseOf = new Map(rs.map(d => [d.admin_category, d.base]));
    sortCats(cats, bkOf(disag), k => baseOf.get(k));
    const val = (cat, opt, k = key) => {
      const r = rs.find(d => d.admin_category === cat && d.option_orig === opt);
      return r ? r[k] : 0;
    };
    const mean = cat => o.reduce((s, d) => s + parseFloat(d.option_orig) * val(cat, d.option_orig, "perc"), 0);
    const oc = cats[0];  // the single Overall category (its spelling varies in the data)
    const full = overall ? c.label : `${c.label} (${BY[disag]})`;
    // subtitle: the question's total respondents (Overall base), plus the multi-select note
    const totalN = rows.find(d => d.variable_orig === c.code && d.admin === "Overall").base;
    const note = [`Відповіли ${totalN.toLocaleString("uk-UA")}`, c.multi ? MULTI_NOTE : null]
      .filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    const dr = dropped.find(d => d.variable_orig === c.code && d.admin === disag && d.n_dropped > 0);
    const noteText = dr
      ? `Не показано ${dr.n_dropped} з ${dr.n_total} ${NOUN[disag]}: менше ніж ${MIN_N} респондентів.` : "";
    const yl = () => cats.map(k => `${k} (n = ${baseOf.get(k)})`);

    // kind: kpi | donut | bar | heat | stack | mean | empty
    let kind, wide = false, slots = 0, build = null, fill = false;
    if (!overall && cats.length < 2) kind = "empty";
    else if (overall && c.overall === "kpi") kind = "kpi";
    else if (overall && c.overall === "donut") kind = "donut";
    else if (overall) kind = "bar";
    else if (c.disag === "heatmap") { kind = "heat"; wide = true; }
    else if (c.disag === "mean") { kind = "mean"; wide = cats.length > 8; }
    else { kind = "stack"; wide = cats.length > 8; }
    const tw = wide ? 120 : 60;

    if (kind === "donut") {
      build = () => ({height: 360,
        traces: [{
          type: "pie", hole: 0.55, sort: false, direction: "clockwise",
          labels: o.map(d => wrap(d.option, 14)),
          values: o.map(d => val(oc, d.option_orig)),
          customdata: o.map(d => val(oc, d.option_orig, "count")),
          marker: {colors: o.map(d => d.color)}, textposition: "outside",
          texttemplate: isCount ? "%{value:,d}" : "%{percent:.1%}",
          hovertemplate: "%{label}<br>%{percent:.1%} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>",
          domain: {x: [0.04, 0.5], y: [0.08, 0.92]}
        }],
        layout: {title: titleOf(full, note, tw), showlegend: true,
          legend: {orientation: "v", x: 0.54, xanchor: "left", y: 0.5, font: {size: 11}},
          margin: {l: 20, r: 20, t: topPx, b: 20}}});
    } else if (kind === "bar" && c.vertical) {
      // columns instead of bars; stretches to the height of its row (see mountGrid)
      const sorted = c.keep_order ? [...o]
        : [...o].sort((a, b) => val(oc, b.option_orig) - val(oc, a.option_orig));
      const labs = sorted.map(d => wrap(d.option, 14));
      const lines = Math.max(...labs.map(t => t.split("<br>").length));
      fill = true;
      build = (sl, fillH) => ({height: Math.max(topPx + 210 + 14 * lines, fillH || 0),
        traces: [{
          type: "bar", orientation: "v", marker: {color: BAR},
          x: labs, y: sorted.map(d => val(oc, d.option_orig)),
          customdata: sorted.map(d => val(oc, d.option_orig, "count")),
          texttemplate: `%{y:${fmt}}`, textposition: "outside", cliponaxis: false,
          hovertemplate: `%{x}<br>%{y:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`
        }],
        layout: {title: titleOf(full, note, tw), margin: {l: 55, r: 20, t: topPx, b: 20},
          xaxis: {type: "category", automargin: true, showgrid: false, tickfont: {size: 11}, tickangle: 0},
          yaxis: {tickformat: fmt, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, range: isCount ? null : [0, 1]}}});
    } else if (kind === "bar") {
      const sorted = c.keep_order ? [...o]
        : [...o].sort((a, b) => val(oc, b.option_orig) - val(oc, a.option_orig));
      slots = o.length;
      build = sl => ({height: topPx + 60 + slotPx * sl,
        traces: [{
          type: "bar", orientation: "h", marker: {color: BAR},
          x: sorted.map(d => val(oc, d.option_orig)),
          y: sorted.map(d => wrap(d.option, 30)),
          customdata: sorted.map(d => val(oc, d.option_orig, "count")),
          texttemplate: `%{x:${fmt}}`, textposition: "outside", cliponaxis: false,
          hovertemplate: `%{y}<br>%{x:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`
        }],
        layout: {title: titleOf(full, note, tw), margin: {l: 10, r: 60, t: topPx, b: 40},
          xaxis: {tickformat: fmt, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, range: isCount ? null : [0, 1]},
          yaxis: yAxis(false, sl)}});
    } else if (kind === "heat") {
      const xl = o.map(d => wrap(d.option, o.length > 8 ? 11 : 16));  // narrower columns -> narrower labels
      const labLines = Math.max(...xl.map(t => t.split("<br>").length));
      const titleLines = wrap(full, tw).split("<br>").length + (note ? 1 : 0);
      const top = 40 + titleLines * 18 + labLines * 14;
      build = () => ({height: top + 26 * cats.length + 60,
        traces: [{
          type: "heatmap", x: xl, y: yl(),
          z: cats.map(k => o.map(d => val(k, d.option_orig))),
          customdata: cats.map(k => o.map(d => val(k, d.option_orig, "count"))),
          colorscale: [[0, "#e8f1fa"], [0.5, "#6fa5d8"], [1, "#143a6b"]],
          zmin: 0, zmax: isCount ? undefined : 1, xgap: 2, ygap: 2,
          texttemplate: isCount ? "%{z:,d}" : "%{z:.0%}",
          colorbar: {tickformat: fmt, thickness: 12, len: 0.6},
          hovertemplate: `%{y}<br>%{x}<br>%{z:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`
        }],
        layout: {title: titleOf(full, note, tw), margin: {l: 215, r: 10, t: top, b: 10},
          xaxis: {type: "category", side: "top", automargin: true, showgrid: false, tickfont: {size: 11}, tickangle: 0},
          yaxis: {type: "category", autorange: "reversed", automargin: true, showgrid: false, tickfont: {size: 11}}}});
    } else if (kind === "stack") {
      // the legend (one wrapped entry per answer) must fit the plot height, or it scrolls
      const legendH = o.reduce((s, d) => s + wrap(d.option, 20).split("<br>").length * 14 + 8, 0);
      slots = Math.max(cats.length, Math.ceil((legendH - 40) / 30));
      const maxBase = Math.max(...cats.map(k => baseOf.get(k)));
      build = sl => ({height: topPx + 80 + 30 * sl,
        traces: o.map(d => ({
          type: "bar", orientation: "h", name: wrap(d.option, 20),
          x: cats.map(k => val(k, d.option_orig)), y: yl(),
          marker: {color: d.color, line: {color: "#ffffff", width: 1}},
          customdata: cats.map(k => val(k, d.option_orig, "count")),
          text: cats.map(k => val(k, d.option_orig, "count") >= 0.07 * (isCount ? maxBase : baseOf.get(k))
            ? (isCount ? String(val(k, d.option_orig, "count")) : (val(k, d.option_orig, "perc") * 100).toFixed(0) + "%") : ""),
          textposition: "inside", insidetextanchor: "middle", textangle: 0,
          textfont: {color: isLight(d.color) ? TXT : "#ffffff", size: 11},
          hovertemplate: `%{y}<br>${d.option}: %{x:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`
        })),
        layout: {title: titleOf(full, note, tw), barmode: "stack",
          margin: {l: 185, r: 190, t: topPx, b: 40},
          xaxis: {tickformat: fmt, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, range: isCount ? null : [0, 1]},
          yaxis: yAxis(wide, sl),
          legend: {orientation: "v", x: 1.01, xanchor: "left", y: 1, yanchor: "top",
                   traceorder: "normal", font: {size: 11}}}});
    } else if (kind === "mean") {
      // average rating (1-5) per category; unaffected by the percent/count switch
      slots = cats.length;
      build = sl => ({height: topPx + 60 + 30 * sl,
        traces: [{
          type: "bar", orientation: "h", marker: {color: KPI},
          x: cats.map(mean), y: yl(),
          customdata: cats.map(k => baseOf.get(k)),
          text: cats.map(k => mean(k).toFixed(1)), textposition: "outside", cliponaxis: false,
          hovertemplate: "%{y}<br>середня оцінка: %{x:.2f}<extra></extra>"
        }],
        layout: {title: titleOf(`${full}, середня оцінка (1–5)`, note, tw), margin: {l: 185, r: 50, t: topPx, b: 40},
          xaxis: {range: [0, 5], dtick: 1, showgrid: false, zeroline: false},
          yaxis: yAxis(wide, sl)}});
    }

    let inner;
    if (kind === "kpi") {
      const base = rs.length ? rs[0].base : 0;
      inner = html`<div class="p1-kpi">
        <div class="p1-kpi-title">${c.label}</div>
        <div class="p1-kpi-value">${mean(oc).toFixed(1)} <small>/ 5</small></div>
        <div class="p1-kpi-n">відповіли ${base.toLocaleString("uk-UA")}</div></div>`;
    } else if (kind === "empty") {
      inner = html`<div class="p1-empty">${c.label}<br><em>Недостатньо даних для порівняння: менше двох ${NOUN[disag]} мають щонайменше ${MIN_N} респондентів.</em></div>`;
    } else {
      inner = html`<div class="p1-plot"></div>`;
    }
    const el = html`<div class="p1-card${wide ? " wide" : ""}">${inner}
      ${noteText ? html`<div class="p1-note">${noteText}</div>` : ""}</div>`;
    return {el, plot: el.querySelector(".p1-plot"), kind, wide, slots, build, fill, useSlots: slots, hint: c.layout_hint};
  };

  const cards = cfgs.filter(c => c.page === page).sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos).map(makeCard);
  return mountGrid(cards, invalidation);
}
```

# Порівняння адміністрації та вчителів

## {.sidebar}

```{r}
#| include: false
# ---- page 5: the two population groups side by side ---------------------------
# Every frequency table in clean_df_harmonized.parquet is split by h_population
# (manager = heads + deputy heads, teacher). Option/category labels in that file
# are English; the Ukrainian ones come from the harmonised KoBo form (`choices`),
# which also says which group each option was asked of (`available_to`).
h <- read_parquet("inputs/dashboard_data/clean_df_harmonized.parquet",
  col_select = c("admin", "admin_category", "admin_category_orig", "option", "option_orig",
                 "variable", "variable_orig", "perc", "general_count", "disaggregations_category_1_orig"))
hk_path <- "inputs/supervision_survey_educators_2_harmonised.xlsx"
hk_survey  <- read.xlsx(hk_path, sheet = "survey")
hk_choices <- read.xlsx(hk_path, sheet = "choices")
hk_choices$label_uk <- decode_entities(hk_choices[[grep("^label::Ukrainian", names(hk_choices))[1]]])
hk_multi <- hk_survey$name[grepl("^select_multiple", hk_survey$type)]

cmp_groups <- hk_choices %>% filter(list_name == "h_population") %>%
  transmute(code = name, label = label_uk) %>% arrange(match(code, c("manager", "teacher")))
exp_lab <- hk_choices %>% filter(list_name == "h_experience") %>% transmute(code = name, label = label_uk)

s5  <- sheet[vapply(sheet$pages, function(p) cmp_page %in% page_of(p), logical(1)), ]
min_n <- as.numeric(spec_of(cmp_page)$min_n)
cmp_breakdowns <- setdiff(strsplit(spec_of(cmp_page)$breakdowns, ";")[[1]], "Overall")
dyn <- s5$name[s5$Graph_type == "dynamic"]
stopifnot(setequal(s5$name, c("h_population", "h_oblast", "h_experience", dyn)))

# Who answered what differs between the groups - say so under the card.
cmp_notes <- c(
  h_barriers      = "Вчителі: лише ті, хто не брав участі. Керівники: усі.",
  h_informed      = "Вчителі відповідали про себе, керівники — про свій колектив.",
  h_sought        = "Вчителі відповідали про себе (брали участь або намагалися замовити), керівники — про свій колектив.",
  h_admin_informs = "Керівники: лише ті, у чиїх закладах супервізію організовують."
)
# Card order, orientation, layout and "hidden under a breakdown" all come from the sheet.
cmp_cfg <- tibble(code = s5$name, pos = s5$Card_order, g = s5$Page_gen_type_graph,
                  layout_hint = coalesce(s5$Layout_hint, "auto"),
                  vertical = coalesce(s5$Orientation_overall == "vertical", FALSE),
                  static = s5$Hidden_when_breakdown == "yes") %>%
  mutate(
    kind  = case_when(code == "h_population" ~ "pop", code %in% c("h_oblast", "h_experience") ~ "comp",
                      code %in% hk_multi ~ "multi", TRUE ~ "single"),
    label = vapply(code, function(cd) h$variable[h$variable_orig == cd][1], character(1)),
    note  = coalesce(unname(cmp_notes[code]), "")
  ) %>% arrange(pos)
if (anyNA(cmp_cfg$pos) || anyDuplicated(cmp_cfg$pos))
  stop("sheet_classification.xlsx: Card_order must be filled and unique on the comparison page", call. = FALSE)
# the comparison page can only draw one chart per kind of card - say so instead of ignoring the sheet
want <- c(pop = "donut", comp = "stacked_bar", multi = "grouped_bar", single = "stacked_bar")
bad  <- cmp_cfg$code[cmp_cfg$g != want[cmp_cfg$kind]]
if (length(bad)) stop("sheet_classification.xlsx: the comparison page cannot draw the chart the sheet asks for: ",
                      paste(bad, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)

# ---- options of the comparison questions (Ukrainian labels, order, colours) ----
cmp_order <- list(h_informed = c("informed", "partly", "not_informed"),
                  h_sought = c("yes", "no", "dont_know"), h_admin_informs = c("yes", "no"))
cmp_opts <- bind_rows(lapply(dyn, function(cd) {
  ch <- hk_choices %>% filter(list_name == cd) %>%
    transmute(code = cd, option_orig = name, option = label_uk, avail = available_to)
  mx <- h %>% filter(variable_orig == cd, admin == "Overall") %>%
    group_by(option_orig) %>% summarise(mx = max(perc), .groups = "drop")
  ch <- ch %>% left_join(mx, by = "option_orig") %>%
    mutate(mx = coalesce(mx, 0), neutral = option_orig %in% neutral_opts)
  ch <- if (!is.null(cmp_order[[cd]])) ch %>% arrange(match(option_orig, cmp_order[[cd]])) else
    ch %>% arrange(neutral, desc(mx))      # multi-select: by the larger of the two shares
  n <- sum(!ch$neutral)
  cols <- if (n == 0) character(0) else if (n <= 5) ramps[[as.character(n)]] else
    colorRampPalette(c("#143a6b", "#bcd6ef"))(n)
  ch$color <- neutral_color
  ch$color[!ch$neutral] <- cols
  ch$rank <- seq_len(nrow(ch))
  ch %>% select(code, option_orig, option, rank, color, avail)
}))

# ---- comparison rows: (question, breakdown, category, group, option) ----------
dr <- h %>%
  filter(variable_orig %in% dyn, admin %in% c("Overall", cmp_breakdowns)) %>%
  transmute(variable_orig, admin, population = disaggregations_category_1_orig, option_orig, perc,
            base = general_count,
            category = case_when(admin == "Overall" ~ "Overall",
                                 admin == "h_experience" ~ exp_lab$label[match(admin_category_orig, exp_lab$code)],
                                 TRUE ~ admin_category))
cells <- dr %>% distinct(variable_orig, admin, category, population, base) %>%
  complete(nesting(variable_orig, admin, category), population = c("manager", "teacher"),
           fill = list(base = 0))
# a category stays if at least ONE group has min_n respondents; the other
# group's cells are blanked in the browser (base < min_n)
keep <- cells %>% filter(admin != "Overall") %>%
  group_by(variable_orig, admin, category) %>% summarise(ok = any(base >= min_n), .groups = "drop")
cmp_dropped <- keep %>% group_by(variable_orig, admin) %>%
  summarise(n_dropped = sum(!ok), n_total = n(), .groups = "drop")

cmp_rows <- cells %>%
  left_join(keep, by = c("variable_orig", "admin", "category")) %>%
  filter(admin == "Overall" | ok) %>%
  inner_join(cmp_opts %>% select(variable_orig = code, option_orig, avail),
             by = "variable_orig", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  # only options this group was asked: "not asked" must not become a 0 %
  filter(avail == "both" | (avail == "teachers_only" & population == "teacher") |
           (avail == "managers_only" & population == "manager")) %>%
  left_join(dr %>% select(variable_orig, admin, category, population, option_orig, perc),
            by = c("variable_orig", "admin", "category", "population", "option_orig")) %>%
  mutate(perc = coalesce(perc, 0), count = round(perc * base)) %>%
  select(variable_orig, admin, category, population, option_orig, perc, count, base)

# ---- static composition of the sample (h_population, h_oblast, h_experience) ----
comp_src <- h %>%
  filter(variable_orig %in% c("h_population", "h_oblast", "h_experience")) %>%
  transmute(code = variable_orig,
            population = if_else(variable_orig == "h_population", option_orig, disaggregations_category_1_orig),
            category = case_when(variable_orig == "h_population" ~ "Усі",
                                 variable_orig == "h_experience" ~ exp_lab$label[match(option_orig, exp_lab$code)],
                                 TRUE ~ option),
            perc, base = general_count, count = round(perc * general_count)) %>%
  complete(nesting(code, category), population = c("manager", "teacher"),
           fill = list(perc = 0, count = 0)) %>%
  group_by(code, population) %>% mutate(base = max(base, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% ungroup()
tot <- comp_src %>% filter(code != "h_population") %>%
  group_by(code, category) %>% summarise(total = sum(count), .groups = "drop")
cmp_dropped <- bind_rows(cmp_dropped,
  tot %>% group_by(variable_orig = code) %>%
    summarise(admin = "static", n_dropped = sum(total < min_n), n_total = n(), .groups = "drop"))
cmp_comp <- comp_src %>% left_join(tot, by = c("code", "category")) %>%
  filter(code == "h_population" | total >= min_n) %>% select(-total)

ojs_define(cmp_cfg = cmp_cfg, cmp_opts = cmp_opts, cmp_rows = cmp_rows, cmp_comp = cmp_comp,
           cmp_dropped = cmp_dropped, cmp_groups = cmp_groups)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
ccfgs = transpose(cmp_cfg)
copts = transpose(cmp_opts)
crows = transpose(cmp_rows)
ccomp = transpose(cmp_comp)
cdropped = transpose(cmp_dropped)
cgroups = transpose(cmp_groups)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Page 5: every card compares the two groups (managers vs teachers).
//  pop    donut of the two groups              (static: ignores the breakdown)
//  comp   100% stacked bar per oblast/experience group: managers vs teachers
//         among that category's respondents   (static)
//  single overall: one 100% stacked bar per group; breakdown: two heatmaps
//  multi  overall: grouped bars (a pair per option, NOT stacked: shares sum
//         above 100 %); breakdown: two heatmaps
renderComparePage = function(disag, valtype, invalidation) {
  const {TXT, wrap, titleOf, isLight, mountGrid, sortCats} = gridKit;
  const CM = "#143a6b", CT = "#6fa5d8";
  const POPS = ["manager", "teacher"];
  const COL = {manager: CM, teacher: CT};
  const glabel = new Map(cgroups.map(d => [d.code, d.label]));
  const bkOf = code => bks.find(b => b.code === code) || {};
  const NOUN = new Proxy({}, {get: (_, k) => bkOf(k).noun_uk});             // from the breakdowns sheet
  const BY = new Proxy({}, {get: (_, k) => bkOf(k).title_suffix_uk});
  const MULTI_NOTE = "Можна обрати кілька варіантів";
  const MIN_N = +pspecs.find(p => +p.page === 5).min_n;                     // from the main sheet
  const isCount = valtype === "count";
  const key = isCount ? "count" : "perc";
  const fmt = isCount ? ",d" : ".0%";
  const overall = disag === "Overall";
  const num = x => Number(x).toLocaleString("uk-UA");
  const asked = (avail, p) => avail === "both" || (avail === "teachers_only" && p === "teacher")
    || (avail === "managers_only" && p === "manager");
  const yAxis = (wide, slots) => ({
    ...(wide ? {autorange: "reversed"} : {range: [slots - 0.5, -0.5]}),
    type: "category", automargin: true, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, tickfont: {size: 11}});
  const only = avail => avail === "teachers_only" ? "<br><i>(лише вчителям)</i>"
    : avail === "managers_only" ? "<br><i>(лише керівникам)</i>" : "";

  // page-wide metrics so cards in a row keep aligned axes
  const topPx = 36 + 17 * (Math.max(1, ...ccfgs.map(c =>
    wrap(`${c.label} (за стажем роботи): співвідношення керівників і вчителів`, 60).split("<br>").length)) + 1);
  const groupedLines = Math.max(1, ...copts.filter(d => ccfgs.find(c => c.code === d.code).kind === "multi")
    .map(d => (wrap(d.option, 30) + only(d.avail)).split("<br>").length));
  const gPx = Math.max(48, 14 * groupedLines + 18);   // px per option in the grouped bars

  const dropNote = (code, adm, what) => {
    const d = cdropped.find(x => x.variable_orig === code && x.admin === adm && x.n_dropped > 0);
    return d ? `Не показано ${d.n_dropped} з ${d.n_total} ${NOUN[code] || NOUN[adm]}: ${what}.` : "";
  };

  const makeCard = c => {
    let wide = false, slots = 0, plots = 1, kind = c.kind, noteLines = [];
    let parts = [];
    const overallRows = crows.filter(d => d.variable_orig === c.code && d.admin === "Overall");
    const baseOfGroup = p => (overallRows.find(d => d.population === p) || {base: 0}).base;
    const sub = extra => [`Відповіли: керівники ${num(baseOfGroup("manager"))} · вчителі ${num(baseOfGroup("teacher"))}`, extra]
      .filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
    let emptyText = null, titleNote = null;

    if (c.kind === "pop") {
      const rs = ccomp.filter(d => d.code === c.code);
      const total = rs.reduce((s, d) => s + d.count, 0);
      const get = (p, k) => rs.find(d => d.population === p)[k];
      parts = [{build: () => ({height: 360, traces: [{
          type: "pie", hole: 0.55, sort: false, direction: "clockwise",
          labels: POPS.map(p => wrap(glabel.get(p), 14)),
          values: POPS.map(p => get(p, key)), customdata: POPS.map(p => get(p, "count")),
          marker: {colors: [CM, CT]}, textposition: "outside",
          texttemplate: isCount ? "%{value:,d}" : "%{percent:.1%}",
          hovertemplate: "%{label}<br>%{percent:.1%} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>",
          domain: {x: [0.04, 0.5], y: [0.08, 0.92]}}],
        layout: {title: titleOf(c.label, `Відповіли ${num(total)}`, 60), showlegend: true,
          legend: {orientation: "v", x: 0.54, xanchor: "left", y: 0.5, font: {size: 11}},
          margin: {l: 20, r: 20, t: topPx, b: 20}}})}];
    } else if (c.kind === "comp") {
      const rs = ccomp.filter(d => d.code === c.code);
      const cats = [...new Set(rs.map(d => d.category))];
      const cnt = (k, p) => rs.find(d => d.category === k && d.population === p).count;
      const tot = k => cnt(k, "manager") + cnt(k, "teacher");
      sortCats(cats, bkOf(c.code), tot);
      const totalAll = ccomp.filter(d => d.code === "h_population").reduce((s, d) => s + d.count, 0);
      const maxTot = Math.max(...cats.map(tot));
      wide = cats.length > 8; slots = c.vertical ? 0 : cats.length;
      noteLines.push(dropNote(c.code, "static", "менше ніж 30 респондентів"));
      if (c.vertical) {
        // 100% stacked columns that stretch to the height of the row
        const labs = cats.map(k => `${wrap(k, 14)}<br>(n = ${tot(k)})`);
        const lines = Math.max(...labs.map(t => t.split("<br>").length));
        parts = [{fill: true, build: (sl, fillH) => ({height: Math.max(topPx + 236 + 14 * lines, fillH || 0),
          traces: POPS.map(p => ({
            type: "bar", orientation: "v", name: glabel.get(p),
            x: labs, y: cats.map(k => isCount ? cnt(k, p) : (tot(k) ? cnt(k, p) / tot(k) : 0)),
            marker: {color: COL[p], line: {color: "#ffffff", width: 1}},
            customdata: cats.map(k => cnt(k, p)),
            text: cats.map(k => {
              const share = tot(k) ? cnt(k, p) / tot(k) : 0;
              const big = isCount ? cnt(k, p) >= 0.07 * maxTot : share >= 0.07;
              return big ? (isCount ? String(cnt(k, p)) : (share * 100).toFixed(0) + "%") : "";
            }),
            textposition: "inside", insidetextanchor: "middle", textangle: 0,
            textfont: {color: isLight(COL[p]) ? TXT : "#ffffff", size: 11},
            hovertemplate: `%{x}<br>${glabel.get(p)}: %{y:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`})),
          layout: {title: titleOf(`${c.label}: співвідношення керівників і вчителів`, `Відповіли ${num(totalAll)}`, 60),
            barmode: "stack", margin: {l: 55, r: 20, t: topPx + 26, b: 20},
            xaxis: {type: "category", automargin: true, showgrid: false, tickfont: {size: 11}, tickangle: 0},
            yaxis: {tickformat: fmt, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, range: isCount ? null : [0, 1]},
            legend: {orientation: "h", x: 0, xanchor: "left", y: 1.01, yanchor: "bottom", traceorder: "normal", font: {size: 11}}}})}];
      } else parts = [{build: sl => ({height: topPx + 80 + 30 * sl,
        traces: POPS.map(p => ({
          type: "bar", orientation: "h", name: glabel.get(p),
          x: cats.map(k => isCount ? cnt(k, p) : (tot(k) ? cnt(k, p) / tot(k) : 0)),
          y: cats.map(k => `${k} (n = ${tot(k)})`),
          marker: {color: COL[p], line: {color: "#ffffff", width: 1}},
          customdata: cats.map(k => cnt(k, p)),
          text: cats.map(k => {
            const share = tot(k) ? cnt(k, p) / tot(k) : 0;
            const big = isCount ? cnt(k, p) >= 0.07 * maxTot : share >= 0.07;
            return big ? (isCount ? String(cnt(k, p)) : (share * 100).toFixed(0) + "%") : "";
          }),
          textposition: "inside", insidetextanchor: "middle", textangle: 0,
          textfont: {color: isLight(COL[p]) ? TXT : "#ffffff", size: 11},
          hovertemplate: `%{y}<br>${glabel.get(p)}: %{x:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`})),
        layout: {title: titleOf(`${c.label}: співвідношення керівників і вчителів`, `Відповіли ${num(totalAll)}`, wide ? 120 : 60),
          barmode: "stack", margin: {l: 185, r: 190, t: topPx, b: 40},
          xaxis: {tickformat: fmt, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, range: isCount ? null : [0, 1]},
          yaxis: yAxis(wide, sl),
          legend: {orientation: "v", x: 1.01, xanchor: "left", y: 1, yanchor: "top", traceorder: "normal", font: {size: 11}}}})}];
    } else {
      const o = copts.filter(d => d.code === c.code).sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);
      const multi = c.kind === "multi";
      const note = multi ? MULTI_NOTE : null;
      const rs = crows.filter(d => d.variable_orig === c.code && d.admin === disag);
      if (c.note) noteLines.push(c.note);
      const val = (cat, p, opt, k = key) => {
        const r = rs.find(d => d.category === cat && d.population === p && d.option_orig === opt);
        return r ? r[k] : null;
      };
      const baseOf = (cat, p) => { const r = rs.find(d => d.category === cat && d.population === p); return r ? r.base : 0; };

      if (overall) {
        const oc = rs[0] ? rs[0].category : null;
        if (!multi) {
          // one 100% stacked bar per group (columns that fill the row when `vertical`)
          slots = c.vertical ? 0 : 2;
          if (c.vertical) parts = [{fill: true, build: (sl, fillH) => ({height: Math.max(topPx + 276, fillH || 0),
            traces: o.map(d => ({
              type: "bar", orientation: "v", name: wrap(d.option, 20),
              x: POPS.map(p => `${wrap(glabel.get(p), 16)}<br>(n = ${baseOfGroup(p)})`),
              y: POPS.map(p => val(oc, p, d.option_orig)),
              marker: {color: d.color, line: {color: "#ffffff", width: 1}},
              customdata: POPS.map(p => val(oc, p, d.option_orig, "count")),
              text: POPS.map(p => val(oc, p, d.option_orig, "perc") >= 0.07
                ? (isCount ? String(val(oc, p, d.option_orig, "count")) : (val(oc, p, d.option_orig, "perc") * 100).toFixed(0) + "%") : ""),
              textposition: "inside", insidetextanchor: "middle", textangle: 0,
              textfont: {color: isLight(d.color) ? TXT : "#ffffff", size: 11},
              hovertemplate: `%{x}<br>${d.option}: %{y:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`})),
            layout: {title: titleOf(c.label, sub(note), 60), barmode: "stack",
              margin: {l: 55, r: 20, t: topPx + 26, b: 20},
              xaxis: {type: "category", automargin: true, showgrid: false, tickfont: {size: 11}, tickangle: 0},
              yaxis: {tickformat: fmt, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, range: isCount ? null : [0, 1]},
              legend: {orientation: "h", x: 0, xanchor: "left", y: 1.01, yanchor: "bottom", traceorder: "normal", font: {size: 11}}}})}];
          else parts = [{build: sl => ({height: topPx + 80 + 30 * sl,
            traces: o.map(d => ({
              type: "bar", orientation: "h", name: wrap(d.option, 20),
              x: POPS.map(p => val(oc, p, d.option_orig)), y: POPS.map(p => `${wrap(glabel.get(p), 24)}<br>(n = ${baseOfGroup(p)})`),
              marker: {color: d.color, line: {color: "#ffffff", width: 1}},
              customdata: POPS.map(p => val(oc, p, d.option_orig, "count")),
              text: POPS.map(p => val(oc, p, d.option_orig, "perc") >= 0.07
                ? (isCount ? String(val(oc, p, d.option_orig, "count")) : (val(oc, p, d.option_orig, "perc") * 100).toFixed(0) + "%") : ""),
              textposition: "inside", insidetextanchor: "middle", textangle: 0,
              textfont: {color: isLight(d.color) ? TXT : "#ffffff", size: 11},
              hovertemplate: `%{y}<br>${d.option}: %{x:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`})),
            layout: {title: titleOf(c.label, sub(note), 60), barmode: "stack",
              margin: {l: 185, r: 190, t: topPx, b: 40},
              xaxis: {tickformat: fmt, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, range: isCount ? null : [0, 1]},
              yaxis: yAxis(false, sl),
              legend: {orientation: "v", x: 1.01, xanchor: "left", y: 1, yanchor: "top", traceorder: "normal", font: {size: 11}}}})}];
        } else {
          // grouped bars: a pair per option; "not asked" = no bar
          slots = o.length;
          parts = [{build: sl => ({height: topPx + 60 + gPx * sl,
            traces: POPS.map(p => ({
              type: "bar", orientation: "h", name: glabel.get(p), marker: {color: COL[p]},
              x: o.map(d => asked(d.avail, p) ? val(oc, p, d.option_orig) : null),
              y: o.map(d => wrap(d.option, 30) + only(d.avail)),
              customdata: o.map(d => asked(d.avail, p) ? val(oc, p, d.option_orig, "count") : null),
              texttemplate: `%{x:${fmt}}`, textposition: "outside", cliponaxis: false,
              hovertemplate: `%{y}<br>${glabel.get(p)}: %{x:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`})),
            layout: {title: titleOf(c.label, sub(note), 60), barmode: "group", margin: {l: 200, r: 60, t: topPx, b: 40},
              xaxis: {tickformat: fmt, showgrid: false, zeroline: false, range: isCount ? null : [0, 1]},
              yaxis: yAxis(false, sl),
              legend: {x: 1, xanchor: "right", y: 0.04, yanchor: "bottom", font: {size: 11}}}})}];
        }
      } else {
        // breakdown: two heatmaps (managers above, teachers below), same colour scale
        const cats = [...new Set(rs.map(d => d.category))];
        const total = k => baseOf(k, "manager") + baseOf(k, "teacher");
        sortCats(cats, bkOf(disag), total);
        if (cats.length < 2) emptyText = `Недостатньо даних для порівняння: менше двох ${NOUN[disag]} мають щонайменше ${MIN_N} респондентів хоча б в одній групі.`;
        else {
          wide = true; plots = 2;
          const shown = (k, p) => baseOf(k, p) >= MIN_N;
          const cell = (k, p, d) => (shown(k, p) && asked(d.avail, p)) ? val(k, p, d.option_orig) : null;
          const cellN = (k, p, d) => (shown(k, p) && asked(d.avail, p)) ? val(k, p, d.option_orig, "count") : null;
          const availRank = a => a === "both" ? 0 : a === "managers_only" ? 1 : 2;
          const oh = [...o].sort((a, b) => availRank(a.avail) - availRank(b.avail) || a.rank - b.rank);
          const zmax = isCount ? Math.max(1, ...cats.flatMap(k => POPS.flatMap(p => oh.map(d => cell(k, p, d) || 0)))) : 1;
          noteLines.push(dropNote(c.code, disag, "у жодній із груп немає 30 респондентів"));
          noteLines.push("Порожні клітинки: група не відповідала на цей варіант або в категорії менше ніж 30 респондентів цієї групи.");
          const subTitle = text => ({text, font: {size: 12, color: TXT}, x: 0.01, xanchor: "left", y: 1,
            yanchor: "top", yref: "container", pad: {t: 6}, automargin: true});
          parts = POPS.map((p, idx) => {
            // drop rows/columns that are empty for THIS group (not asked, or < MIN_N respondents),
            // and say how many were left out
            const rowsP = cats.filter(k => oh.some(d => cell(k, p, d) !== null));
            const colsP = oh.filter(d => cats.some(k => cell(k, p, d) !== null));
            const hr = cats.length - rowsP.length, hc = oh.length - colsP.length;
            const comment = (hr || hc)
              ? `${p === "manager" ? "Керівники" : "Вчителі"}: не показано ${hr} з ${cats.length} рядків і ${hc} з ${oh.length} стовпців через відсутність даних для цієї категорії` : "";
            const many = colsP.length > 12;
            const xl = colsP.map(d => wrap(d.option, many ? 9 : colsP.length > 8 ? 12 : 16));
            const labLines = xl.length ? Math.max(...xl.map(t => t.split("<br>").length)) : 1;
            // the shared (first) title is larger and underlined so both heatmaps read as one topic
            const bigLines = wrap(`${c.label} (${BY[disag]})`, 95).split("<br>");
            const titleLines = bigLines.length * 1.25 + 1 + (comment ? 1 : 0);
            const top = idx === 0 ? 46 + titleLines * 18 + labLines * 14 : 24 + (comment ? 18 : 0) + labLines * 14;
            const title = idx === 0
              ? {...titleOf("", "", 95),
                 text: bigLines.map(l => `<span style="text-decoration:underline">${l}</span>`).join("<br>")
                   + `<br><span style="font-size:12px;font-weight:normal;text-decoration:none">${sub(note)}${comment ? `<br>${comment}` : ""}</span>`,
                 font: {size: 18, color: TXT}}
              : (comment ? subTitle(comment) : undefined);
            const ytitle = {text: wrap(glabel.get(p), 18), font: {size: 12}, standoff: 22};
            if (!rowsP.length || !colsP.length) {
              // nothing to show for this group at all
              return {build: () => ({height: top + 70, traces: [],
                layout: {...(title ? {title} : {}), margin: {l: 215, r: 10, t: top - labLines * 14 + 10, b: 10},
                  xaxis: {visible: false}, yaxis: {visible: false, title: ytitle},
                  annotations: [{text: "Немає даних для цієї групи", showarrow: false, xref: "paper", yref: "paper",
                    x: 0, y: 0.5, xanchor: "left", font: {size: 12, color: TXT}}]}})};
            }
            return {build: () => ({height: top + 26 * rowsP.length + 50,
              traces: [{type: "heatmap", x: xl, y: rowsP.map(k => `${k} (n = ${baseOf(k, p)})`),
                z: rowsP.map(k => colsP.map(d => cell(k, p, d))),
                customdata: rowsP.map(k => colsP.map(d => cellN(k, p, d))),
                colorscale: [[0, "#e8f1fa"], [0.5, "#6fa5d8"], [1, "#143a6b"]],
                zmin: 0, zmax, xgap: 2, ygap: 2, hoverongaps: false,
                texttemplate: isCount ? "%{z:,d}" : "%{z:.0%}", showscale: idx === 0,
                colorbar: {tickformat: fmt, thickness: 12, len: 0.9},
                hovertemplate: `%{y}<br>%{x}<br>${glabel.get(p)}: %{z:${fmt}} (n = %{customdata})<extra></extra>`}],
              layout: {...(title ? {title} : {}),
                margin: {l: 215, r: 10, t: top, b: 10},
                xaxis: {type: "category", side: "top", automargin: true, showgrid: false, tickfont: {size: many ? 10 : 11}, tickangle: 0},
                yaxis: {type: "category", autorange: "reversed", automargin: true, showgrid: false, tickfont: {size: 11},
                        title: ytitle}}})};
          });
        }
      }
    }

    const foot = noteLines.filter(Boolean).map(t => `<div class="p1-note">${t}</div>`).join("");
    const inner = emptyText
      ? `<div class="p1-empty">${c.label}<br><em>${emptyText}</em></div>`
      : Array.from({length: plots}, () => `<div class="p1-plot"></div>`).join("");
    const el = html`<div class="p1-card${wide ? " wide" : ""}"></div>`;
    el.innerHTML = inner + foot;
    const divs = [...el.querySelectorAll(".p1-plot")];
    parts.forEach((p, i) => { p.plot = divs[i]; });
    return {el, wide, slots, useSlots: slots, parts, hint: c.layout_hint};
  };

  // static composition cards only make sense for the overall view
  const cards = ccfgs.filter(c => overall || !c.static).sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos).map(makeCard);
  return mountGrid(cards, invalidation);
}
```
